relationship: Modified Version of Lalezar under SIL Open Font License 1.1

original_font.metadata_evidence: The bundled Lalezar-METADATA.pb and original font name records 0, 5, 8, 9, 13 and 14 were inspected.

changes: Rename primary font family to Alan Font, with derivative identity distinguished from Lalezar.
Add focused Sorani support for U+0695, U+06B5, U+06C6, U+06CE and U+06D5, with glyph/shaping implementation documented by the build.
Preserve original Lalezar copyright and SIL OFL 1.1 licensing; acknowledge the original designer.

added_character_support.unicode_name: ARABIC LETTER REH WITH SMALL V BELOW
ARABIC LETTER LAM WITH SMALL V
ARABIC LETTER YEH WITH SMALL V

licensing.reserved_name_note: No Reserved Font Name declaration appears in the actual bundled Lalezar-OFL.txt. No new declaration is added on behalf of the original authors.
licensing.adaptation_copyright_note: No personal author name or additional copyright owner was supplied. The project credit identifies the adaptation without asserting exclusive ownership of the original Lalezar design.
licensing.redistribution_summary: Retain original copyright and OFL 1.1; redistribute the font and derivatives under OFL 1.1; do not sell the font by itself or imply endorsement by original authors.
licensing.artwork_note: Using or embedding the font does not require resulting graphics, videos or documents to be licensed under the OFL.

official_references.purpose: Official SIL FAQ 1.1–1.1.2 (artwork), 1.12–1.13 (embedding), 3.1 (modification/copyright), 3.6 (public release not required), 5.7 (no RFNs by default).
Official guidance on attribution, renaming and documenting modifications.
